chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.enab: Big switchy. Wen false, teh vanilla Anvil region filez r usd unchangd. Turnin it off does NOT convert nething: old .cso filez stay on disk, n chunkz savd onli in dem becom invisibl 2 teh vanilla reeder.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.grid: Bukkit grid edge size. A 32x32 region iz split in2 grid x grid bukkits. Biggr grid = smalr bukkits = less write amplificashun but weaker compresion. Onli 4 newly made region filez; old filez keep dere own grid. Measurd on a 889 MB city save: grid 16 makz write volyum n write taim about half ov grid 8, 4 about 7.5% moar space. Grid 32 iz worse than 16 - 1 chunk per bukkit looz teh bonus ov sharin a compresion context. 1 = hole region iz 1 bukkit (best ratio, worst write cost; cold archivez). 8 = 16 chunkz per bukkit. 16 = 4 chunkz per bukkit (default: lowest write cost).
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.zstd: zstd levul 4 teh hot write path. 3 iz teh default trade-off; hi levuls squeez bettr but rite sloer.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.cach: De-squeezd bukkitz keepd in memree per region file. Moar = less read amplificashun near teh kitteh, but costz heap. Cache also has a 8 MB per-file budget — smal gridz meen 1 bukkit can hold hole regionz worth ov chunkz, n 1 biggr than teh budget iz not cachd at al. A bukkit holdz up 2 (32/grid)^2 chunkz; at grid=8 datz 16 chunkz.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.veri: Sniff evry bukkitz CRC32 wen readin. Smelz rotten data insted ov quietly givin u garbage or empty chunkz. Keep dis on unless u iz doin benchmarks.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.fall: If a chunk iz missin from teh .cso file, fall bak n read teh old .mca. Dis makz teh mod safe 2 us on ur existin wurld: nuthin alredy savd iz lost, n new writez slowli move 2 teh new format.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.comp: Least wastd bytez be4 a region file getz compaktd.
Least wastd/live ratio be4 compakshun (0.25 = 25% wast).
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.batc: Ritin 1 chunk meanz re-squeezin its hole bukkit, so writez get stashd n flushd per bukkit: N chunkz in 1 bukkit cost 1 squeeze, not N. Dis iz how many chunkz 2 stash be4 flushin erly. Set 2 1 2 turn off batchin.
Longest taim stashd writez can sit in memree be4 bein forcdd 2 disk. Limitz how much iz lost if teh gaem goez ded. Autosav flushes neway.
